text:
Hey everyone! 👋

After 1 1/2 years visa process I finally received my visa 😍 and I couldn’t be more excited (picture of happiness with my partner holding my visa haha)

Thank you so much for all the throughout support here in the group 🤍

Since I now have a working visa, I am seeking a job and hence wanted to reach out for any hints. 

A bit about me:
- I’m originally from Germany
- ⁠I spent four years working at a finance tech unicorn, growing from cold calling to leading the DACH sales team. 
- ⁠I now want to move into Customer Success or Account Management.
- ⁠I’m also open to roles in Sales Enablement or Revenue Operations where my background fits as well. 
- ⁠I’m a Native German speaker, fluent in English with deep DACH / EMEA market experience
- ⁠here’s my LinkedIn profile, I’m happy to connect 🙂: https://www.linkedin.com/in/theresa--graf/

If you know someone hiring or just want to connect over coffee, I’d love that. 

And if I can ever return the favour (sales process questions, team structuring, enablement, customer conversation advice) I’m always happy to help.
